newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Airline sets 1-27 reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Airline sets 1-27 reverse split.

text.p: International Airline Support Group Inc said Friday that its completed financial restructuring included a one-for-27 reverse stock split.

The company said it has about 3 million shares of common stock outstanding after the reverse split. It said its common stock will begin trading on a post-reverse-split-basis October 8 under the symbol "IFLY."

The aircraft spare parts supplier said its restructuring also included the issuance of about 2.2 million shares of common stock for 100 percent of outstanding principal of its 8 percent convertible subordinated debt due 2003 and the redemption of its 12 percent senior secured notes due 1997.
